Maya (CS): Pinging billing + support — GammaGames (acct GG-112) escalated: invoice vs dashboard mismatch after EOM.
Maya (CS): Invoice 2026-03-31-INV-98765 shows $1,238.45, dashboard shows $1,228.45. Net diff +10.00 but line-level shows a +28.20 'reserved-burst' and a -18.20 credit missing from dashboard. Customer is asking for reconciliation before renewals.
Ava (Support): Any plan changes or quota adjustments near cutoff? Could be proration or postback churn.
Maya (CS): Customer says no changes. They provided invoice CSV and the dashboard export. Gist: https://redwood.internal/cs/gamma/inv-98765 (internal)
Rohit (Billing): I pulled invoice 98765. The extra +28.20 maps to a reserved-burst line (qty 6 @ 4.70). Dashboard export shows 0 reserved-burst for 3/31. Possible routing mismatch where those requests were served by Dedicated pool but dashboard snapshot used Hosted counters.
Ava (Support): Can you share the meter query so I can cross-check ingestion/postback?
Maya (CS): Quick SQL they ran: ```SELECT route, SUM(token_count) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='GG-112' AND day='2026-03-31' GROUP BY route;``` Customer CSV shows text-gen tokens=12,345 on 3/31.
Ava (Support): Ran that against usage_export_v2: text-gen tokens = 12,345. I also see a duplicate postback for 2026-03-31 23:59:58 with idempotency key 'pbk-4123' — looks like a retry landed across partition boundary :eyes:.
Leo (SRE): Logs from postback-processor: ```2026-03-31T23:59:58Z postback id=pbk-4123 status=sent
2026-04-01T00:00:05Z postback id=pbk-4123 status=sent (retry)``` That retry crossed midnight; cutoff window is 00:00 UTC snapshot. If retry wrote into the next day's partition we could end up double-counting in billing if downstream dedupe didn't catch cross-partition duplicates.
Rohit (Billing): Billing pipeline dedupe is partition-local for performance. If the duplicate fell into a different partition key (day boundary) it won't dedupe. That explains the extra reserved-burst line. But what about the missing -18.20 credit?
Maya (CS): There's an adjustments row for invoice 98765: -18.20 source='auto-reconcile' created 2026-04-02 09:12. Dashboard snapshot was taken 2026-04-01 00:05 so it didn't include that adjustment. Invoice regenerated includes the adjustment but UI/export used earlier snapshot -> timeline mismatch.
Ava (Support): So root cause = (1) postback retry crossing cutoff -> duplicate usage record across partitions, and (2) backfill/auto-reconcile created an adjustment after dashboard snapshot but before final invoice regeneration. Two separate timing issues.
Rohit (Billing): Action plan: (a) add cross-partition dedupe for postback idempotency in billing preprocessor, (b) audit backfill job that created auto-reconcile adjustments and make it annotate 'post-invoice' so UI shows pending adjustments, (c) issue provisional credit to customer.
Leo (SRE): I'll attach postback-processor logs and run id: run-2026-04-02-03-14 to the ticket. Confirming fix for idempotency handling is in next sprint.
Rohit (Billing): I'll open BILL-5421 with query snapshots and invoice diffs, cc'ing infra. Provisional credit of $18.20 approved pending final audit. :+1:
Maya (CS): I'll message GammaGames with apologies, provisional credit notice, and ETA (target 2026-04-10). I'll include steps to reproduce the counts for them so they understand the timeline.
InvoiceBot: Ticket BILL-5421 created by Rohit (Billing). ETA: 2026-04-10.
Maya (CS): Notes for runbook: add a monthly check for cross-cutoff postbacks and record adjustment creation time vs dashboard snapshot time. Put this under 'EOM reconciliation checklist'.
Ava (Support): Moving thread to #escalated-billing and keeping updates here. Will post final root-cause once BILL-5421 lands. :wave:
